description: backend/services/simulation_runtime/scheduler.py::_post_close_terminalize_miniqmt_run (~2160) decides the end-of-day terminal status of a MiniQMT run using ONLY the open_order_evidence/submit_result_gate written into run.run_payload_json at submit-time reconcile, and _miniqmt_post_close_terminal_status (~2213) keys on that stale open_order_count. The post-close path never calls _sync_miniqmt_snapshot or a fresh broker open-order/trade query before deciding. Consequence: an order open at submit but FILLED later in the trading day is still terminalized FAILED_TERMINAL because stale evidence shows open_order_count>0, contradicting actual broker fills (residual root-cause class of BUG-369/396/414). Design miniqmt_unified_vnpy_execution_runtime_design_20260608.md (4.1 durable event loop / OMS ledger as source of truth; 6.2 reconcile-success-must-not-overwrite-failure) requires terminal decisions to use fresh broker/ledger facts, not submit-time snapshots.
expected: Before post-close terminalization the run MUST re-reconcile from fresh broker facts (_sync_miniqmt_snapshot + recomputed open-order evidence, or reuse _reconcile_after_submit); terminal status reflects end-of-day broker state; filled orders are never marked FAILED_TERMINAL; include reconcile audit (as_of/source); no silent fallback to stale payload.
non_goals: Do not restart production runtime services without explicit approval.
